title: New Perspectives Grant Applications Open for Amsterdam
paragraphs: New Perspectives Grant Applications Open for Amsterdam
New PerspectivesNew Perspectives | Art by Darek Zabrocki

If you've ever wanted a chance to go to Amsterdam for a MagicCon event but were worried about funds, this news may be for you. The New Perspectives grant program is open for applications! This grant program, funded by Wizards of the Coast, offers MagicCon tickets and a travel stipend to ten players. This program has been going on for a few years now, and if you thnk you qualify, it's a great time to apply!
According to Magic.gg, Wizards of the Coast's main competitive play hub, those awarded the grant receive the following:'

Applicants have between now and February 19th, 2026, at 8 AM Pacific Time (11 AM Eastern) to apply. There are additional rules and regulations involved with eligibility and accepting the New Perspectives grant. We will cover those below:

You also need to be 18 years of age or older to apply for this grant. Furthermore, to apply, you'll need a valid Wizards account. While marginalized people are encouraged to apply, this information will not be shared with the evaluating team, and entries are anonymized.
You can find the application for this grant program by clicking here or by visiting Magic.gg's page on the matter.

And now, let's open the floor to you, dear readers! Have you applied to the New Perspectives grant program in the past? Will you do so? And, have you attended any MagicCon events before or are planning to do so soon? Sound off in the comments!

Josh Nelson wears many hats. They are a music journalist when not writing gaming news. Beyond this, they're a scholar of the Sweeney Todd urban legend, a fan of monster-taming RPGs, and a filthy Aristocrats player. Josh has been playing Magic since 2001 and attributes their tenure to nostalgia, effort, and "aesthetic".
